Price 4,000 gp; Slot none; Weight —

A palm-sized Androffan memory crystal that plays back, in light and sound, the evening the kasatha ambassadors spent on the entertainment deck. Once per day, a kasatha who spends a minute watching it gains a +2 morale bonus on attack rolls and Will saves for 1 hour.

Found in: Episode 2 (Lot 5) or The Ambassadors.

effect: Kasatha: +2 morale on attacks and Will saves
